answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 7637 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamualaikum 1-If some people are able to view the Cresent(Moon)for Ramadhan and Eid through a Telescope but are unable to see the Moon without the Telescope is such a sighting valid in Shariah?Please provide refrence and name of Mufti saheb. Jazakumullah Question: Asalamualaikum 1-If some people are able to view the Cresent(Moon)for Ramadhan and Eid through a Telescope but are unable to see the Moon without the Telescope is such a sighting valid in Shariah?Please provide refrence and name of Mufti saheb. Jazakumullah Answer ID: 7637 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1941/1717=B/1429) Sighting moon through telescope is not acceptable. The Shariah does not regard it binding. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
